crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute…
For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have…
After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know Yahweh…
Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck, like the neck of their fathers, who didn’t believe in…
They rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to…
“Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets…
not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out…

translations.web: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
translations.bsb: They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law.
translations.kjv: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
translations.asv: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;
